title: Creator Prefixes
description: Adds Live, Recording, and AFK toggle triggers, which add prefixes before your name on the tab list!
body:
**Adds Live, Recording, and AFK toggle triggers, which add prefixes before your name on the tab list!**

### COMMANDS

In order to activate a prefix, a player must use one of the three following commands:
  -    **/trigger live** to activate the " LIVE ⏺ " prefix
  -    **/trigger rec** to activate the " REC ⏺ " prefix
  -    **/trigger afk** to activate the " _**AFK**_ " prefix

Using one of the three triggers will **_override_** any others, so if you have one selected, you will lose your current prefix and gain the prefix you triggered.

In order to **remove** your prefix, simply enter the trigger command again, and it will toggle **off**.

### WARNING :


This datapack uses _teams_, so be aware that any use of teams through other datapacks or without, will break the system.
